images.title: Lasso the circles into groups
images.purpose: Shows the regrouping tool's core move in its simplest state: Step 2 of the circle pattern lassoed into two groups, giving one expression for the count.
images.composition: One small circle arrangement centred, with two rounded lasso outlines around its groups and the expressions underneath. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no people, no extra text.
images.exact_structure: Eight equal circles on a 3 by 3 grid of positions with the bottom right position left empty: rows of 3, 3 and 2 from top to bottom. The top two rows (6 circles) are teal (#0072B2) and enclosed by one rounded reddish purple (#CC79A7) lasso outline. The 2 circles of the bottom row are amber (#E69F00) and enclosed by a second rounded reddish purple lasso outline. The label 'Step 2' above the arrangement. Below it, centred, the label '2 × 3 + 2 = 8', and under that the label 'k(k + 1) + k'. Exactly 8 circles and 2 lassos.

images.takeaway: Each way of grouping a pattern gives an expression for its count.

image_decisions.why: The practice describes patterns and areas more than one way; one lasso grouping shows the move the tool makes, without giving away any practice answer.
